pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal and star-shaped patches with jagged, high-frequency edge gradients. Patches on the lower neck are vertically elongated, while flank patches show greater radial complexity with multiple acute vertices.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored negative space forming a continuous interconnected web. Corridor thickness varies, with significant widening at multi-patch junction nodes on the mid-flank and lower torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Consistent, low-amplitude serrated profile along the neck ridge formed by uniform light-brown hair. The silhouette is finely textured against the sky background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized, dark circular anomaly is visible on the upper shoulder/lower neck ridge, characterized by higher pigment density than the surrounding pattern.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct star-burst geometry of the flank patches, characterized by multiple sharp projections extending into the negative space corridors.
